Decision Support

Decision Support workflow for coding agents. Use when the user needs to choose between alternatives.

Workflow

  1. Identify the requested outcome and supplied evidence.
  2. Compare relevant options against explicit criteria; state uncertain inputs.
  3. Verify the output contract and preserve uncertainty.

Populated example

Request: Choose merge or rebase.

Compare shared-history safety, linear history, and conflict handling.

Use the helper

compare_options

Source: skills/decision-support/SKILL.md in the package. Use this workflow selectively; it does not override user or system instructions.
